disagreements.expansive_position: Anyone can reproduce and verify the release, so custody and handoff may be supported.
disagreements.adversarial_position: Canonical publishing authority and signature remain person-keyed; reproduction does not transfer authority, credentials, or open decisions.

disagreements.expansive_position: Public source, checklists, and testing documentation make the project independently resumable.
disagreements.adversarial_position: Critical assurance assets, canonical controls, and operational checklist state remain restricted or privately backed up.

disagreements.expansive_position: The project continues without the focal co-creator, so person-level custody should be added.
disagreements.adversarial_position: Continuation is collective and source-addressable, but the focal person's outgoing package, recipient, and transition action are not isolated.

disagreements.expansive_position: Public code and named collaborators establish handoff and reduced founder dependency.
disagreements.adversarial_position: The public surface omits full service data, credentials, incident state, partner intake, and authority transfer.
